reviewer: codex inline adversarial reviewer after implementation
reviewerConstraint: The user limited further work to inline execution and no additional subagents. This pass was separated by role and evidence criteria from the implementation pass, but organizational or model independence is not claimed.

findings.finding: A deterministic structural and lexical reviewer had labeled 156 automatically derived rows independently implementable even though that derivation did not constitute a full mechanism-level semantic interpretation.
findings.resolution: All automatically derived safe rows are now pattern references, sensitive or external rows remain deferred, and malicious fixtures remain rejected. Automatically derived rows cannot originate candidate capability claims.

findings.finding: Digest-bound comparison indexes proved corpus coverage but did not independently prove that an existing owner was behaviorally stronger for each generated candidate cluster.
findings.resolution: All generated overlap decisions are terminally deferred. Only the 98 hand-adjudicated candidates retain covered, extension, or new-skill decisions, and unimplemented or stale-receipt outcomes remain deferred.

findings.finding: A covered owner could have been treated as promoted from a receipt that did not bind the current exact owner contract.
findings.resolution: Retained promotion requires the current exact contract digest inside a passing promotion receipt. Missing or stale owner receipts fail closed to deferred.

findings.finding: The terminal certificate bound the adversarial review artifact but did not reconcile each declared review-scope digest and byte count against the current reviewed artifacts.
findings.resolution: Certification now requires an exact, duplicate-free five-artifact scope match for reviews, clusters, overlaps, synthesis, and routing. Any stale or missing scope row fails closed.

acceptedLimitations: Deterministic local fixtures do not prove arbitrary live-model routing or universal semantic truth.
Automatically derived reviews remain cold pattern evidence and are not independent implementation claims.
Reviewer independence beyond this recorded separate adversarial pass is not proven.
Deferred candidate mechanisms require their own independent implementation, critical fixtures, and measured baseline improvement before promotion.
